# 1.2.72 - the guard on Daggerheart's relay reads its new route

The nineteenth stage on the way to 1.3.0 (E75), released on its own.
Daggerheart 2.10.10 changed how its relay hands a player's request to the
GM's browser. The module's guard on that relay now reads the new route: a
player's browser passes on only the requests Daggerheart's own cases
handle, and a countdown a player's action starts is refused with words the
GM and the player can read, as it was before 2.10.10. The headless harness
now runs Daggerheart 2.10.11's relay; on Daggerheart 2.10.9 and earlier
nothing changes (read in the code: the harness runs only 2.10.11, and the
check at a table is LIVE-E75-04).

## At the table

- **A player's action that starts a countdown** creates no countdown on
  Daggerheart 2.10.10 and later. The primary GM reads "Refused a
  Daggerheart change from *player*: new countdowns (*name*). Nothing was
  changed.", the player is told "This game leaves that change to the
  GM.", and `game.drpg.relayGuard().refused` counts it under
  `countdownsFromAction` (measured in the headless harness: scenario 30,
  and R345 holds the verdict; at a table it is LIVE-E75-01). The same
  request from a full Gamemaster goes on to Daggerheart (scenario 30).
- **`game.drpg.relayGuard()`** lists the relay's default branch in its
  `fingerprint` on Daggerheart 2.10.10 and later. The branch is read
  whole, so a Daggerheart whose default branch is not the one reviewed,
  or adds a statement to it, reads `state` "changed" and names it under
  `unreviewed` (R344, on stand-in listeners; at a table it is
  LIVE-E75-03); the GM's whisper about unreviewed cases quotes it as code
  (read in the code).

## Changed

- **A player's browser** hands Daggerheart's relay only the eight request
  names the guard has reviewed; any other name is not run there (scenario
  30, part 8).
- **The guard's last-resort backstop**, used when the guard cannot sit in
  front of Daggerheart's listener, now clears a refused request's contents
  as well as its name (R343, scenario 30).
- **The headless harness** runs Daggerheart 2.10.11's relay, copied from
  the tag (`audit/harness/lib/dh-relay.mjs`); its copy of Daggerheart's
  dice code is unchanged.
- **New tests**, R343 to R345, and new checks in scenario 30's part 8.
- **The manifest is unchanged**: Daggerheart `minimum` and `verified`
  stay 2.6.5, Foundry `verified` stays 14.365.

## Known gaps

- Daggerheart's built file that a table loads (`build/daggerheart.js`) is
  not in Daggerheart's repository and was not read; the guard's reading of
  the default branch is measured on the source and on stand-ins only
  (LIVE-E75-03).
- What a second player's browser shows when another player's action
  starts a countdown is read in the code, not tried at a table
  (LIVE-E75-02).
- With two GMs only the primary judges the countdown; the other leaves
  it (read in the code: the harness has one GM).
- A Daggerheart older than 2.10.10 is not run in the harness any more
  (LIVE-E75-04).
- Foundry 14.369 with Daggerheart 2.10.11 was read about, not run
  (LIVE-E75-05). The work for newer Daggerheart and Foundry versions is
  stage E76, before 1.3.0.
